rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=400, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-4 CONVERGENCE probe. iter-3 (tv_lambda=1e-4) COLLAPSED hr 0.1665->0.0217 (under-regularized: on 128-view sparse the data term drags in streaks/noise faster than PWLS helps) => lower lambda is the WRONG direction; revert to lambda=1e-3. At lambda=1e-3 plain TV only reaches hr=0.1665/ssim=0.96 in 200 GD iters at lr=0.01 — the data-consistency solve may not be converged. ONE knob: tv_iterations 200->400 (double GD steps, same lambda/lr, gamma=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: more iters enforce data-consistency further so hr climbs past 0.1665; if it saturates the solve is already converged and I pivot to lr/optimizer. Budget: iter-1 200s -> ~400s at 2x iters, <<1200s.
